Alltech ONE Conference registration now open

Event to cover trends shaping the future, from artificial intelligence and emerging technologies to sustainability and workforce transformation.

Industry ReleaseOctober 1, 2026

schedule2 Min Read

Alltech

Registration is now open for the Alltech ONE Conference, which brings together global thought leaders and changemakers for an immersive exploration of science, sustainability and storytelling, and of the bold ideas shaping the future of agriculture. The conference regularly attracts an international audience, with past participants representing more than 90 countries. Building on more than 40 years of bringing together the agri-food industry, ONE returns home to Lexington, Kentucky, on May 24-26, 2027.

In addition to its mainstage program, the Alltech ONE Conference will feature 11 immersive content tracks covering aquaculture, beef, crop science, dairy, equine, pet, pork, poultry, food systems, business and talent, and Africa. Through expert-led sessions, dynamic panel discussions and real-world case studies, attendees will explore the innovations, technologies and ideas that are transforming the future of agriculture and food production.

Related:Legislation introduced to address U.S. veterinarian shortage

Across the conference program, attendees will learn about the trends shaping the future, from artificial intelligence and emerging technologies to sustainability, food security, global market dynamics and workforce transformation. Sessions will highlight innovative approaches to improving productivity, advancing animal and crop performance, strengthening business resilience, and meeting the growing demand for nutritious, sustainable food around the world.

“The most important breakthroughs begin with conversations and connections,” said Mark Lyons, president and CEO of Alltech. “The Alltech ONE Conference creates a unique environment where scientists, food producers, entrepreneurs, business leaders and storytellers come together to explore the ideas that will define the future. From artificial intelligence and biodiversity to food security and global market trends, our goal is to create an environment where new thinking, inspiration and dialogue help attendees turn insight into action.”

Beyond the conference sessions, ONE will offer attendees a vibrant event experience designed to foster connection, conversation and community. Attendees can enjoy evening gatherings throughout the conference, including a music and food festival at Lexington Brewing & Distilling Co. Following the conference, there will be expanded opportunities to explore the region through specialized post-conference tours.

Early-bird registration is available for a limited time. Those who register now can access the lowest conference rates and be among the first to experience the keynotes, immersive tracks, networking opportunities and transformative discussions that define the Alltech ONE Conference.

Related:Celebrate pig caregivers: Zoetis awards nominations open now

To register, or for more information, visit the website.

translationZh:
Alltech ONE大会现已开放注册，该大会汇聚全球思想领袖和变革者，围绕科学、可持续发展和叙事展开沉浸式探索，并探讨塑造农业未来的大胆构想。该大会定期吸引国际受众，往届参会者来自90多个国家。在凝聚农业食品行业40多年的基础上，ONE大会将于2027年5月24-26日回到肯塔基州莱克星顿举办。

除主舞台议程外，Alltech ONE大会还将推出11个沉浸式内容板块，涵盖水产、肉牛、作物科学、奶牛、马业、宠物、猪业、家禽、食品系统、商业与人才以及非洲。通过专家主导的会议、动态小组讨论和真实案例研究，参会者将探索正在改变农业和食品生产未来的创新、技术和理念。

相关阅读：美国提出解决兽医短缺的立法

在整个大会议程中，参会者将了解塑造未来的趋势，从人工智能和新兴技术到可持续发展、食品安全、全球市场动态和劳动力转型。会议将重点介绍提高生产力、推进动物和作物表现、增强企业韧性以及满足全球对营养、可持续食品日益增长的需求的创新方法。

“最重要的突破始于对话和连接，”Alltech总裁兼首席执行官Mark Lyons表示。“Alltech ONE大会创造了一个独特的环境，让科学家、食品生产者、企业家、商业领袖和叙事者齐聚一堂，探索将定义未来的理念。从人工智能和生物多样性到食品安全和全球市场趋势，我们的目标是创造一个环境，让新思维、灵感和对话帮助参会者将洞察转化为行动。”

除会议议程外，ONE还将为参会者提供充满活力的大会体验，旨在促进连接、对话和社区感。参会者可以在整个大会期间享受晚间聚会，包括在莱克星顿酿酒与蒸馏公司举办的音乐和美食节。大会结束后，还将有更多机会通过专门的会后游览探索该地区。

早鸟注册限时开放。现在注册的人可以享受最低大会价格，并率先体验主题演讲、沉浸式板块、社交机会以及定义Alltech ONE大会的变革性讨论。

相关阅读：庆祝养猪护理人员：硕腾奖提名现已开放

如需注册或了解更多信息，请访问网站。
